root_family.definition: Professional diagnostic, maintenance, screen replacement, and hardware repair services for smartphones, laptops, TVs, and home appliances.
inclusion_rules: Smartphone screen fitting and glass replacement labor
Refrigerator gas refilling and compressor replacement
exclusion_rules: Physical replacement screens and display parts without labor (see Consumer Electronics)

children.canonical_name: Smartphone Screen & Hardware Repair Services (የስልክ ጥገና)
